tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (nya)༄༅/ /gu ru pad+ma 'od 'bar gyi bsreg blugs kyi cho ga nyes skyon mun stug zla ba'i gsar sgron zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /rigs brgya'i bdag po
(nya)༄༅/ /gu ru pad+ma 'od 'bar gyi bsreg blugs kyi cho ga nyes skyon mun stug zla ba'i gsar sgron zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /rigs brgya'i bdag po

tei:div.tei:p: (nya)༄༅// gu ru pad+ma 'od 'bar gyi bsreg blugs kyi cho ga nyes skyon mun stug zla ba'i gsar sgron zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rigs brgya'i bdag po bla ma dkon mchog spyi// kun 'dus bdag nyid snyigs dus 'gro ba la// thugs rje che myur pad+ma sam+bha war// gus pas btud de de yi me mchod brtsam// zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya ba la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ sbyor ba'i thog mar sngar sa chog ma byas pa'i sa phyogs yin na/ sa chog bsdus pa bya ba ni/ sa gzhi der rang nyid 'khod pa'i mdun du gtor ma gcig bshams pa chus bran te/ rang lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ zhes brjod pas gtor rdzas kyi ma dag pa bsreg gtor bkrus pa'i ngang las/ rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur ces dang*/ 'dod rgyal gyi phyag rgya bcas la/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra a kā ro sogs gsum mam lngas gtor ma bsngos la/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ hūm̐ sa phyogs 'di na gnas pa yi// sa bdag lha klu 'khor dang bcas// gtor ma dam pa 'di bzhes la// bdag gi las mthar ma phyin bar// khyed la gnas 'di bdag g.yar gyi// ci bde bar ni gzhan du dengs// dpal ldan bla ma dam pa sogs nas/ sa yi phyogs 'dir gu ru pad+ma 'od 'bar gyi sbyin sreg gi cho ga bgyid par 'tshal na/ sa yi phyogs 'di bdag la gnang zhing las kyi bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bar chad thams cad zhi ba'i stong grogs mdzod cig ces dang*/ muḥgang dag sogs nas gzhan du songs shig sarba bigh+nān gats+tsha/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ a rtsig ni rtsig sogs drag po'i sngags brjod cing*/ gtor ma phyir dor/ rol mo dang bcas te/ gu gul bdug yungs kar gyis phyogs kun du brabs te bgegs bsal lo// de nas lha'i nga rgyal brtan pos/

oṃ bhū khaṃ zhes brjod cing dkyil 'khor sa phyogs thams cad lag pas bcags la sa phyogs nam mkha'i rang bzhin du bsam/ de bzhin du oṃ ha na ha na kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces mang du brjod pas sa phyogs skyon thams cad dang bral bar bsams pa ni sa sbyong ba'o// sa gzhi der/ sbyor ba thab dang bud shing sbar ba me// rdzas dang bsham thabs sgrub pa po ste drug /ces pa ltar las/ dang po zhi ba'i thab khung gi tshad spyi ltar btab pa brus pa'am/ brtsigs pa'am/ bris thab gang bde lag len ltar bya/ thab kyi dbus su lha'i mtshan ma me tog tshom bu'am/ rdul tshon dkar po'i tshom bu bkod/ zhal 'jig rten pa'i nub tu phyogs pa'i dbang du byas/ gnyis pa bud shing ni/ tsher ma can ma yin pa 'o ma can gyi shing sor bcu gnyis pa thab kyi kha sgyer gyi steng nas zlum por rtsig de ma 'byor na ba lang sogs kyi gci ba srog chags med pas kyang btub bo// nang gi shar lhor ting lo che ba zhig kyang gzhag go /gsum pa me ni rdo dang lcags gtsubs pa las byung ba ma yin pa rgyun zhag gi me'am 'o ma can gtsubs pa sogs las byung ba'o// bzhi pa rdzas ni/ bsreg rdzas dang mchod rdzas dang gtor ma dang ku sha'i chun po la sogs pa 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad rnams gtsang zhing gya nom pa sta gon bya'o// lnga pa bsham thabs ni/ thab kyi mtha' skor thams cad byi dor legs par byas la dri bzang gi chus byug drug pa thab kyi nub tu sgrub pa po'i stan nang tshangs can sogs shar du phyogs par bya/ mdun du rdor dril gyi bar du dgang gzar blugs kha sbyar la bzhag dri bzang gi chu ku sha'i 'thor yab dang bcas/ grub na sgrub pa po'i bar du 'jim pa las byas pa'i me yol dkar zhal gyis byugs par waṃ yig dkar po bris pa'ang bsham/ rang gi g.yon thab kyi g.yas nas chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod dang*/ bla ma'i gtor ma zlum gtor sman phud rak+ta bcas dang me lha la zlum gtor gcig bsham/

rang gi g.yas thab kyi g.yon logs su rang ngos nas brtsams te/ yam shing mar til zas mchog dang*// 'bras dang so ba nas sran ma// gro dang dūr wa ku sha rnams// lag len ji bzhin legs par bsham// zhes pa'i go rim ltar bsham/ ku sha'i chun po brgyad dang dpal 'bar rnams stabs gang bder gzhag la/ yo byad thams cad dri bzang gi chus gtor te gzhag go /snga dro'i dus su rang nyid khrus byas/ 'byor na gos rgyan dkar pos brgyan la/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dang bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi ba'i phyir sbyin sreg gi cho ga la 'jug snyam pa'i bsam pa brtan pos sngar bshams pa'i stan la kha shar du bltas/ skyil krung ngam pus 'khyud dang bcas pa'i tsog pu rkang pa gnyis cung zad bsnol ba rig byed 'don pa lta bu'i spyod lam gyis 'dug go /dngos gzhi la/ bdag gi rnal 'byor me btsal yo byad bsang*// thab khung 'dus byas 'jig rten me lha mchod// 'das pa'i me lha mchod rnams dngos gzhi'i chos// zhes pa ltar las/ dang po bdag gi rnal 'byor ni/ thog mar skyabs 'gro sems bskyed nas brtsams te/ gnyis med rol pa chen por phyag 'tshal bstod/ zhes pa'i bar gzhung bzhin nyams su blangs la/ bzlas pa bya ba ni/ rang gi snying gar pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar gser gyi rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa la sngags kyi phreng bas bskor bar gyur pa bsam zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐/ zhes pa ci nus bzlas mthar/ gu ru rin po ches bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad zhi ba dang*/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes 'dod don gsol ba gdab bo// 'di nas bzung ste sbyin sreg gi cho ga ma grub kyi bar la lag pa gnyis pus mo las phyir mi 'da' ba la bslab bo// gnyis pa me btsal ba ni/ dpal 'bar la gong du bshad pa'i me sbar te lag pa gnyis gus pa'i tshul gyis thab la g.yas nas zlum por bskor zhing sid+dhi'i sngags lan gsum sngon du 'gro ba'i/

oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la raṃ/ zhes brjod de/ thab kyi nang gi ting lo sbar te me gso/ de nas lag pa g.yon khu tshur bcangs pa'i mdzub mo dang mthe bong brkyang bas dgang gzar dang*/ g.yas khu tshur bcangs pa'i mthe bong brkyang ba byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas blugs gzar bzung la/ blugs gzar mar dang bcas pas dgang gzar gyi kha la reg cing zlum por g.yas skor gyi tshul gyis mar bud shing la khyab par blugs te/ oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la raṃ zhes brjod/ gsum pa thab dang yo byad bsang ba ni/ rang lha'i nga rgyal gyis bsang chu la hūm̐ nyer gcig la sogs pa bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs nas sngags de nyid brjod cing ku sha'i 'thor yab kyis thab dang yo byad rnams la gtor/ mchod rdzas dang bsreg rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rang gi gnas gsum yig 'bru gsum gyis mtshan// de las zer ma phyogs bcur rab 'phros pas// mchod rdzas dngos 'dzin rnam rtog bag chags dang*// nyes skyon bsregs gtor sbyangs bkrus bdud rtsir gyur// sman rag gtor mchod 'od phung ldems se ldems// bla med mchod pa dpag yas bsam mi khyab// mchod yul dgyes shing las rnams sgrub byed pa'i// nus pa phun tshogs nam mkha' gang bar gyur// zhes brjod la mchod rdzas rnams oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs nas shab+da'i bar rang rang gi sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlab/ bsreg rdzas rnams mchod yon gyi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hās yam shing dang*/ oṃ shrīṃ swā hās mar/ oṃ dz+riṃ swā hās 'bru/ oṃ swa swā hās rdzas thams cad bkru/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hās rdzas thams cad sbyangs te byin gyis brlab bo// bzhi pa thab swa bhā was stong par sbyangs la/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las byung ba'i zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ rgyar khru gang pa/

dpangs su khru phyed pa kha sgyer ram mu ran la rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba/ phyi rol gyi grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa bris pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ lnga pa thab kyi nang du raṃ las me dkar gsal du 'bar ba'i dbus su paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du raṃ las bgrang phreng raṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ me lha ra skyes dkar po la chibs pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas bgrang phreng*/ g.yon spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ lus po me'i rang bzhin dmar po/ zhal gyi dkyil 'khor dkar po las 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba/ gsus khyim che ba ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ smin ma dang sma ra dkar ser 'bar ba/ ag tshom 'phyang ba drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ bsam/ de'i thugs ka'i raṃ dang rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ shar lho nas me lha drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes dang*/ lag pa gnyis kyi mthe bong gung mo'i rtsar bzhag mdzub mos gung mo'i rgyab nas bkab pa dbyug gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya rna ba'i drung du g.yab cing*/ hūm̐ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis// tshur gshegs tshur gshegs lha chen po// me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /bsreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi zhes pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs dam tshig pa la gnyis su med par bstim/ slar yang snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa māḥdzaḥzhes dang rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs nas sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/

zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan par bsam/ de nas ag+ne sa pa ri wā ra zhes pa'i mtshan sngags re re'i 'gor sbyar ba'i chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo bcas dang*/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i ma hā pañca rak+ta khā hi/ zhes dang*/ mtheb srin gyis nang mchod 'thor ro// rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ gzi brjid 'bar ba me yi lha// 'bar bcas sku ni rgyan gyis brgyan// rngams pa'i byin chen las la brtson// bsreg blugs 'bul lo las kun sgrubs// tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras// zhi la sogs pa'i dngos grub ni// ji ltar 'dod pa'i don sgrub pa// gzi brjid rgyal por phyag 'tshal bstod// ces pas bstod/ de nas ku sha'i chun po brgyad mi dmigs te/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa thab dang yo byad rnams kyi 'bags pa dang ma dag pa sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par bsams te/ ku sha 'di ni bzang zhing dge /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /tshangs pa yi ni dag byed yin// dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de// des bdag la gegs med cing zhi bar mdzod cig /oṃ badz+ra satwa a zhes brjod cing thab kyi mdun nas g.yas skor gyi rim pas phyogs mtshams brgyad du dgram mo// de nas bsang chus phyogs kun du gtor te hūm̐ brjod pas bgegs bsal lo// de nas gzar bu gnyis byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas bzung ste/ me lha'i zhal cung zad gdangs pa'i ljags hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa la raṃ bsam/ dgang blugs gnyis kyi gzar bu'i kha la'ang raṃ bsams te/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes lan bdun brjod cing mar blugs gzar bdun gyis dgang gzar bkang la mthar/ oṃ ag+na ye a dī bya dī bya ma hā shrī ye ha bya ka bya bā ha nā ya bdag dang sbyin bdag gis gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dang*/

nad dang gdon bgegs dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba la sogs pa'i bar du gcod pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā zhes pa lta bu gang mos dang*/ bsnyen pa'i skabs yin na gsang sngags kyi lhag chad nyes pa thams cad ces pa lta bu kha bsgyur shes par bya'o// gang gi tshe gzar bu gnyis kha sbyar te me lha'i zhal du phul/ de lta bu lan gsum gyis byon zan phul/ de nas bsreg rdzas rnams lag pa g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis blangs la mchod/ mchog sbyin phyag rgyas dbul te/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣā ya swā hā/ yam shing*/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ mar/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+rā ya swā hā/ til lam yungs kar/ oṃ sarba saṃ pa de swā hā/ zho dang sbyar ba'i zas mchog oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swā hā/ 'bras/ oṃ badz+ra bi dza ya swā hā/ 'bras so ba/ oṃ ma hā ba lā ya swā hā/ sran ma/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma rā ya swā hā/ gro/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ dūr wa/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+rā ya swā hā/ zhes pas ku sha rnams 'bul ba'am/ yang na sngags de rnams lan gsum gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ ag+na ye 'ba' zhig gis phul/ gang ltar yang nyer gcig la sogs pa ci 'byor pa'i mthar/ bdag dang sbyin bdag gis gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dang*/ nad dang gdon bgegs dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba la sogs pa sngar ltar las sngags spel tshig sde tshan re re'i mthar brjod do// de nas chu gnyis sngon du 'gro bas nyer spyod dang bstod pa sngar ltar byas te/ mar dgang gzar gang thub tu blugs te badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ zhes brjod la/ me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur par bsam mo// drug pa 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ hrīḥdakar gsal me 'od rab tu 'bar ba'i klong*// dkon mchog spyi 'dus pad+ma 'od 'bar sku// zhes sogs nas spyan 'dren gyi mjug tu oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa mā ya sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ zhes dang*/

phyag 'tshal ba ni/ na mo skye 'gag 'gyur med phrin las rdzogs// rang byung thugs rje'i 'gro rnams sgrol// yid bzhin dngos grub char 'bebs pa'i// pad+ma 'od 'bar sku la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes phyag byas la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pas mdun bskyed la gnyis su med par thim par bsam/ de'i mtha' skor du rtsa brgyud bla ma sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor bar gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsams la/ lha thams cad 'dzum zhing zhi ba 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba dang sdud pa'i sgo nas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dang bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi ba'i las mdzad par bsams la/ de nas gzar bu gnyis blangs te lha thams cad zhal cung zad gdangs pa sogs sngar ltar gsal btab ste/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐/ zhes pa lan 'ga' zhig brjod pas mar la bsngags te/ oṃ ag+ne ye swā hā/ zhes lan bdun gyis blugs gzar gyis mar blugs pas dgang gzar bkang la mthar/ oṃ ag+na ye a dī bya dī bya zhes sogs swā hā'i gong du bdag dang sbyin bdag gi gtsor byas pa'i sems can thams cad sogs spel tshig gong ltar brjod de/ gzar bu gnyis kha sbyar la lha thams cad zhal du dus gcig la phul bar bsam/ de lta bu lan gsum la sogs pas byon skyems phul/ mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ mchod 'os phyi nang snod bcud sogs nas/ phyi nang mchod pa dang bstod pa'i mjug gnyis med rol pa chen por phyag 'tshal bstod// ces pa'i bar dkyus ltar bya'o// de nas yam shing nas brtsams te bsreg rdzas rnams sde tshan re re'i thog mar bo dhi bṛk+ṣa la sogs pa'i so so'i sngags gsum mam lnga la sogs pa sngon du 'gro ba'i badz+ra gu ru 'ba' zhig gi brgya rtsa re 'bul ba'i mthar spel tshig gong ltar brjod/ de bzhin du mar la sogs pa'ang rigs 'gre phul/

de nas til dkar nag mdun du 'dus byas la bdag gzhan gyi las dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa til nag la thim/ dkar po la shes bya'i sgrib pa thim/ mar la de ma yin pa'i sgrib pa rnams thim/ zhes brjod cing bsams la/ sid+dhi'i sngags zlos shing phul bas sdig sgrib thams cad tshig nas bde ba chen po'i ngo bor gyur par bsam/ grangs ni/ bsnyen pa'i skabs yin na bcu cha dang*/ gzhan du grangs ji ltar rigs pa bsags la/ bar skabs rnams su yam shing dang mar ni me'i tshod dang sbyar te sgrub g.yog gis log nas 'bul/ bsreg rdzas rnams rdzogs pa dang gong byon skyems kyi skabs su bshad pa ltar mar dgang blugs gsum 'bul/ mchod gtor rnams kha gsos la byin gyis brlabs te 'bul ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ mchod 'os phyi nang snod bcud sogs nas ma hā pañca rak+ta ba liṃ ta khā hi zhes pas mchod/ bstod pa rgyal ba thams cad ye shes klong du sogs sh+lau ka gcig gis bstod/ gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis bdag dang sbyin bdag gi gtsor byas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi nad dang gdon bgegs kyi gnod pa dus ma yin par 'chi ba la sogs pa'i bar du gcod pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab bo// de nas skabs 'dir tshogs mchod 'bul ba ni/ tshogs rdzas rnams chab kyis bran la/ hrīḥbadag nyid lha yi thugs ka nas/ zhes sogs nas kiṃ ni ri ti ga na tsakra pū tsa khā hi zhes pa'i bar brjod pas/ tshogs phud phul/ de nas rnal 'byor pa rnams tshogs la rol/ lhag ma la kha phru btab/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lhag la dbang ba dregs pa'i tshogs// zhes pa nas uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta khā hi zhes pas lhag ma phyir dor la/ oṃ pad+ma satwa sa ma ya sogs snang ba mtha' yas kyi yig brgya lan gsum dang ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// ces sogs kyi mthar/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra muḥ zhes dang mtheb srin gyi se gol gyi sgras ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par bsam/ srin lag gis thab kyi rdul cung zad blangs la dpral bar bskus te dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam mo// gsum pa rjes ni/ me lha lhag mas mchod dang gtor ma btang*// 'dod don zhus la gshegs gsol lhag chad bskang*// las kyi rjes bsdu ba ste drug yin no// zhes pa ltar las dang po dang gnyis pa ni/ thab tu mar blugs gzar gang dgang gzar la reg pa dang bcas pas blugs la/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ zhes brjod de/ me lha 'bar ba zhal phyag gi rnam pa can du gyur par bsams la/ bsreg rdzas rnams ni lhag ma bdun nam bcu gcig gam nyer gcig la sogs pa ci 'byor pa phul/ mthar byon zan gyi skabs ltar mar dgang blugs gsum gang ba'i sbyin sreg tu phul/ me lha 'khor bcas la gtor ma gong ltar ram/ mi nus na raṃ yaṃ khaṃ brjod pas gtor rdzas kyi ma dag pa bsregs gtor bkrus pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur zhes brjod la/ oṃ ag+ne sa pa ri wā ra ma hā pañca rak+ta ba liṃ ta khā hi zhes sogs kyis phul/ mtshan sngags re re nas sngon du 'gro ba'i chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pa dang*/ gzi brjid 'bar ba sogs kyis bstod/ gsum pa 'dod don zhu ba/ drang srong chen po 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis bdag dang sbyin bdag sogs sngar bzhin 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ bzhi pa dang lnga pa go rim cung zad bsnol te/ yig brgya lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskang*/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don// byin za khyod kyis sgrubs kyis gshegs// ji bzhin dus su slar gshegs te// bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrubs// oṃ ag+ne sa pa ri wā ra gats+tsha zhes dang*/ dbyug gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya phyir bskyed de/ me lha rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsams la/

drug pa rjes la/ bdag bskyed kyi bsdu rim ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ snod bcud snang srid thams cad sogs nas/ gdod ma'i kun bzang mjal bar gyur// zhes dang*/ gzugs snang thams cad gsal stong sogs dang*/ dge ba 'di yis myur du sogs kyi smon lam ci shes dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ shes bya'i don la ma rmongs pa'i// bla ma dam pa'i bkra shis shog /gang la bsam pa de yi 'grub// yi dam lha yi bkra shis shog /sku gsung thugs kyi bha ga la// phyag rgya chen po'i bkra shis shog /nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs// nyi ma'i gung yang bde legs shing*// nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa// dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis shog /ces bkra shis kyis cho gas mtha' brgyan par bya'o// mchog gi dngos grub sgrub pa yin na/ me ma shi'i bar du mi bsgul/ shi ba dang gzhan reg tu mi gzhug par rang gis phyags la/ thal ba 'dod pa rnams la'ang sbyin zhing lhag ma 'bab chu la sogs pa dor/ thun mong gi dngos grub tsam la 'phral du phyags pas rung ngo*// thab kyi shul dang nye 'khor thams cad dri zhim po'i chus byugs te/ me tog la sogs pa gtor la bkra shis bya'o// smras pa/ sngags spyod me lce 'bar bas sdig sgrib dang*// bar chad phyogs ngan bsreg pa'i ngo mtshar 'dis// yal ga'i ri dwags mjug ma'i byin za yis// laṅka'i grong khyer 'bar ba phra mor byas// tshul 'dir legs byas 'bad pa'i kat+pu ras// cher snyigs lnga bdo'i dus kyi bro rims dang*// gdon bgegs nye zhos gdung ba yongs bcil nas// bde dga' de rgyu bcas la spyod gyur cig /ces gu ru pad+ma 'od 'bar gyi bsreg blugs kyi cho ga nyes skyon mun stug za ba'i gsal sgron zhes bya ba 'di ni/ dpal sa skya pa'i phrin las kyi zla snang phyogs su spro ba'i mdo sngags rab 'byams pa sangs rgyas bzang po'i gsung gis bskul ba'i ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas thun mtshams su bris pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig

rtsa rgyud bla ma'i byin rlabs sprin phung g.yo// yi dam dngos grub ci 'dod char rgyun 'bebs// bstan srung phrin las sde bzhi'i lo thog legs// che gsum bkra shis 'gro la smin gyur cig /ces pa'i bkra shis mdor bsdus 'di'ang tshul rin gyis bris pa'o// // ༄༅// rta mgrin skyer sgang lugs kyi sbyin sreg cho ga me lha dgyes pa'i mchod sprin zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// gzi brjid 'bum phrag 'bar ba bskal pa'i mes// sdig sgrib bar chad za ba'i mthu rdzogs na// ye shes khro bo rta mchog nus pa'i rjes// mngon par bsngags so mchog gi me lhar 'dud// gang gi bsgom bzlas sngon song rnal 'byor pas// rang gzhan don du mchog dang thun mong gi /dngos grub zung gi khengs ldan mdza' na bo// 'gugs byed sreg blugs yid 'phrog zur mig ngom// ye shes 'jig rten bsreg bya za ba'i lha// rnam mang mchod rdzas dam pas mnyes byas pas// sdig sgrib bar chad gcod pa mi mthun phyogs// zhi bde'i dngos grub sbyin pa'i cho ga bgyi// tshul 'di'i sbyor ba thab dang yo byad bsham// dngos gzhi bdag bskyed phal mchog me lha mchod// rjes ni mchod cing bzod par gsol te gshegs// bkra shis dbyangs kyis mtha' mar brgyan bya'o// zhes pa ltar gyi thog mar zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi sbyor ba la/ sa gzhi mnyam par thig chen brgyad btab pa'i dbus nas mtho gang gi tshad kyis zlum por bskor bas khru gang 'byung zhing*/ de'i phyi rol du'ang sor bzhi pa lan gnyis kyis bskor bas kha khyer dang mu ran 'byung*/ tshangs thig dang mu ran 'dzom pa nas zur bzhir mtshan ma btsal te stegs bu gru bzhir gdab/ mu ran la rdo rje kha zums pa'i phreng ba dang*/ phyi rol gyi stegs bu'i grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa bri/ gzhi tshon thams cad dkar po la bcad tshon dmar skyas bya/ thab dbus nas sum gcig lte ba dang*/

sum gnyis pad+ma 'dab brgyad bya/ dbus su lha'i mtshan ma tshon phung dmar po bkod do// gnyis pa yo byad bsham pa ni/ mu ran gyi steng nas bud shing 'o ma can nam/ srog chags med pa'i nags kyi lci ba skam po zlum por brtsig de'i nang 'jig rten pa'i shar lhor me tshang gi ting lo che ba bzhag nub nas sgrub pa po zhal shar tu phyogs par 'gyur ba'i stan nang tshangs can dkar po btings pa'i mdun du me yol pha gu la dkar rtsis byugs pa dang*/ mdun du stegs kyi khar rdo rje dril bu'i bar du dgang gzar dang blugs gzar kha sbyar ba dang nang mchod bsang chu 'thor yab bcas zhag sgrub pa po'i g.yas logs nas rim par/ yam shing mar til zas mchog dang*// 'bras dang so ba nas sran ma// gro dang dūrba ku sha rnams// zhes pa'i go rim dang mthun pa ste/ yam shing 'o ma can gyi rigs mar khu/ til lam yungs kar zas mchog ni dkar mngar gyi rigs dang phye zho bsres pa dang gzhan ni go bar sla'o// de'ang bsreg rdzas so sor 'os pa rnams 'jig rten pa'i me lha la sngon du nyer gcig lta bu ji tsam 'bul ba de'i grangs dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha la brgya rtsa dang lhag ma bdun sogs gang dgos bcas rnams tshar gnyis so sor bshams nas byin rlabs dus gcig byed pa ni phyag len shin tu legs pa mngon/ g.yon logs nas chu gnyis nyer spyod dang 'das gtor dang me lha'i zlum gtor gnyis bsham mo// dngos gzhi la gsum gyi dang por bdag bskyed pa ni/ phyi dro'i dus la sogs par zhwa gos dkar pos brgyan te skyil krung ngam rig byed 'don pa lta bu'i spyod lam dang ldan pas rang gzhan gyi sdig sgrib la sogs pa zhi bar byed pa'i sems dang ldan pas 'khod de/ skyabs su 'gro ba nas brtsams te/ rta mgrin skyer sgang lugs kyi sgrub thabs gang yin bzlas pa'i rjes kyi 'dod don gsol ba gdab pa'i bar gzhung bzhin nyams su blang ngo*// gnyis pa phal pa'i me lha mchod pa la/

thog mar bsang chur a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa lan bdun bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs te bzhag 'di nas brtsams te sbyin sreg gi cho ga ma grub bar la lag pa gnyis pus mo las phyir mi 'da' bar bya'o// de nas rgyun zhag gi me'am 'o ma can gyi shing gtsubs pa las byung ba'i mes sbar ba'i dpal 'bar lag pa gnyis kyis gus pa'i tshul gyis bzung nas thab la g.yas nas zlum por lan gsum du bskor zhing*/ ngag tu oṃ pad+man+ta krita sogs dang oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ zhes brjod cing me tshang du gzhug la rtswa skam sogs dang bcas pas me sbar/ de nas dgang blugs byang chub mchog gi khu tshur te/ lag pa g.yon pa khu tshur las mdzub mo brkyang bas dgang gzar bzung*/ g.yas pa khu tshur gyis blugs gzar bzung nas blugs gzar mar dang bcas pas dgang gzar gyi khar reg pas mar khu bud shing la khyab par blugs te me gso/ skabs 'dir me bra ngan na bsang chur sngags brjod pas gtor/ slar yang bsang chus rdzas rnams la gtor zhing bsang*/ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa'i nye bar spyod pa rnams dang*/ yam shing la sogs pa'i bsreg rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ lha mnyes pa dang so so'i las sgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par bsams la/ so so'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da āḥhūm̐ gi bar dang*/ mchod yon gyi phyag rgya dang oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hās yam shing*/ oṃ shrīṃ swā hās mar/ oṃ dz+riṃ swā hās rdzas rnams bkru/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hās rdzas thams cad sbyangs te byin gyis brlab bo// thab sngar bzhin bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po dwangs shing thogs pa med pa rgya dang tshad ma nyams pa/

mu ran la rdo rje'i phreng ba dang phyi rol gyi grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan cing*/ nang lha rdzas kyi bud shing gis bkang ba dang bcas par gyur par bsam/ de nas thab kyi dbus su pad+ma'i gdan la raṃ las bgrang phreng raṃ gyis mtshan pa las me lha ra skyes la chibs pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas bgrang phreng*/ g.yon spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ lus po me'i rang bzhin dmar po/ zhal gyi dkyil 'khor dkar po las 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba/ gsus khyim che ba/ ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ sma ra dang smin ma dkar ser 'bar ba/ ag tshom 'phyang ba/ drang srong gi tshogs kyi bskor ba/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas shar lho nas me lha drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes dang*/ lag pa gnyis kyi mthe bong gung mo'i rtsar bzhag mdzub mo gung mo'i rgyab nas bkab pa dbyug gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya rna ba'i drung du g.yab cing*/ tshur spyon tshur spyon 'byung po che// me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// gzi brjid chen po me yi lha// 'dod pa thams cad sgrub pa po// thugs rjes sems can don mdzad pa// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi zhes brjod pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pas dam tshig par gnyis su med par thim par bsam/ slar yang snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa sngar bzhin spyan drangs la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan par bsam mo// ku sha'i chun po brgyad bsang sbyangs/

stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa/ dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ thab dang yo byad rnams kyi 'bags pa dang ma dag pa sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par bsam zhing*/ oṃ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de// tshangs pa yi yang dag byed yin// des bdag la gegs med cing zhi bar mdzod cig swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra satwa a/ zhes brjod cing thab kyi mthar phyogs mtshams brgyad du g.yas skor du dgram mo// de nas gzar bu gnyis byang chub mchog gi khu tshur gyis bzung ste/ me lha'i zhal cung zad gdangs pa'i ljags hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od kyi sbu gu byung bas/ dgang blugs gnyis kyi kha'i raṃ la phog nas mar khu gsol bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ ag+na e swā hā zhes brjod cing mar blugs gzar bdun gyis dgang gzar bkang la mthar dgang blugs gnyis kha sbyar te/ oṃ ag+na ye a dī byā dī bya ma hā shrī ye ha bya ka bya ba ha na ya swā hā zhes pas me lha'i zhal du phul bar bsam/ de lta bu lan gsum gyis byon zan phul la/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra re re'i sngon du 'gro ba'i chu gnyis nyer spyod ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi dang bcas pas mchod cing*/ rdo rje dril bu dang bcas te/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mchog gi sras// me lha'i rgyal po mchog tu dbang bskur zhing*// shes rab me yis nyon mongs thams cad sreg /'jigs byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud// ces pas bstod/ de nas bsreg rdzas rnams lag pa g.yon pas bzung*/ g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis steng nas len cing mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas dbul ba'i tshul bya ste/ de'ang rdzas so so'i rang sngags oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣā ya swā hā/ yam shing*/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ mar/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+rā ya swā hā/

til lam yungs kar/ oṃ sarba saṃ pa de swā hā/ zho dang sbyar ba'i zas mchog oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swā hā/ 'bras/ oṃ badz+ra bi dzā ya swā hā/ 'bras so ba/ oṃ ma hā be gā ya swā hā/ nas/ oṃ ma hā ba lā ya swā hā/ sran ma/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma rā ya swā hā/ gro/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ dūrba/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+rā ya swā hā/ zhes pas ku sha rnams 'bul ba'am yang na sngags de rnams lan gsum sngon du 'gro ba'i oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ 'ba' zhig gis phul/ gang ltar yang nyer gcig la sogs pa ci 'byor phul ba'i mthar/ bdag gis tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dang nye bar 'tshe ba dus ma yin par 'chi ba/ gsang sngags kyi lhag chad la sogs pa'i nyes pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes las sngags kyi spel tshig sde tshan re re'i mthar brjod do// de nas chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i mchod pa dang 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod dang bstod pa sngar bzhin byas la/ mar dgang gzar gang thab tu phul/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ zhes dang me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur par bsam mo// gsum pa mchog gi me lha mchod pa ni/ me 'bar ba'i klong du e las chos kyi 'byung gnas sogs nas/ sgrub thabs ngag dbang chos grags pas mdzad pa sogs mang du snang ba las rang gang mos pa'i yig cha ltar bskyed la ye shes pa spyan drangs nas bstim/ de'i mtha' skor du rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba dang bcas par dmigs la/ de thams cad 'dzum zhing zhi ba/ 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba dang sdud pa'i sgo nas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dang bar chad thams cad zhi ba'i las mdzad par bsam zhing brjod/ gtso bo de rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma dang tha dad med par dmigs la/ gzar bu gnyis blangs nas lha rnams kyi zhal cung zad gdangs pa'i ljags hūm̐ las rdo rje sogs sngar bzhin bsams la/

oṃ hrīḥpad+man+ta krita badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa lan gsum gyi mar la bsngags te/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā lan bdun gyis mar khu phul mthar/ a dī byā di bya sogs dang bdag gi tshe 'khor ba sogs spel tshig gong bzhin brjod/ gzar bu gnyis kha sbyar la lha rnams kyi zhal du dus gcig la dbul bar bsam/ de lta bu lan gsum gyis byon zan phul/ de nas mchod pa byin rlabs ni/ bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod sogs gong ltar las rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs nas shab+da āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ spro na/ mchod yon phal cher la sogs pa'i tshigs bcad ji ltar rigs pa'i mthar so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ ha ya grī wa sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā nas so so'i kha bsgyur ba dang bcas pas oṃ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐ gi bar dharma ra ṇi rol mor bcas dang*/ gos zung bsang sbyangs/ srab 'jam yang ba lha yi gos// mi phyed rdo rje'i sku la gsol// mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul na// bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog /oṃ ha ya grī wa sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra was+t+rā ya āḥhūm̐ zhes pas gos zung dang*/ nang mchod sngar byin rlabs ma byas na 'bru gsum lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ nang mchod g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis 'thor ba dang bcas te/ bka' drin zla med rtsa ba'i bla ma dang brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ hrīḥpad+man+ta krita sogs kyi mthar khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog rol pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lus kyi lha rnams la mchod par bsams la/ rang gi snying ga mgrin pa spyi gtsug rnams su reg ste oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod/ bar phud gtor ma la bran nas/ chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/

gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ nor lha gter bdag rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'gro ba rigs drug lhar gsal ba'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ tshim zhing zag pa med pa'i bde bas rgyud gang nas myur du sangs rgyas thob pa'i skal pa dang ldan par gyur cig ces pas nang mchod phul/ bstod pa ni/ hrīḥrgyal ba kun gyi chos sku pad+ma'i gdung*// chos rje 'od dpag med pa rdo rje chos// spyan ras gzigs dbang hrīḥlas rngam chen sku// rta mgrin rta skad bzhad la phyag 'tshal lo// dbang chen kun 'dus dbang gi rgyal po ste// dbang gi mdog dmar bskal pa'i me 'dra las// dbang chen rngam brjid nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi// dbang mdzad dbang gi sku la phyag 'tshal lo// thugs rje byams pa'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang*// las ngan gdug pa'i sems can sgrol mdzad pa// zhe sdang gtum khro dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar// rngam brjid 'gying ba'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod pa'i mchod pa rnams bya'o// de nas yam shing la sogs pa'i bsreg rdzas thams cad pa'i sde tshan re re'i thog mar/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣā ya la sogs rdzas sngags gsum mam lnga sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ hrīḥpad+man+ta krita sogs lha sngags 'ba' zhig gis brgya rtsa re dbul zhing sde tshan re'i mthar spel tshig gong ltar gdags/ de'ang yam shing 'bar ba'i me la'o// zhu ba'i rdzas rnams zhal dang gong bu'i rdzas rnams phyag tu 'bul lo// de nas til mdun du bzhag pa la bdag gi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis bdag gzhan gyi sdig sgrib dang bar du gcod pa thams cad kaṃ yig nag po'i rnam par bsdus nas bstim/ slar yang de'i steng na a yig dkar po zhig bsams te/ de'i 'od zer til la phog pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur pa lha'i zhal du phul bar bsams la/ lha sngags brgya rtsa re'i mtshams su spel tshig btags la bsnyen pa ji tsam song ba'i bcu cha'i til 'bul/

sgrub g.yog gis me rgyun ma chad tsam gyi mar dang yam shing gis me rgyun gso/ slar yang byon zan gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar mar dgang blugs gsum phul/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos pa byin gyis brlabs nas/ mtshan sngags gong ltar spel ba'i ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas phyi mchod dang 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul la/ bstod pa sngar gyi thog ma'i sh+lau ka gcig pus bstod/ gtor ma 'das gtor bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥyis byin gyis brlabs nas rtsa sngags la i daṃ ba lin+ta gṛh+ṇā pa ya gṛh+ṇā pa ya kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa lan gsum mam bdun gyis phul nas mchod bstod mdor bsdus dang 'dod don zhu/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum dang ma 'byor pa sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra muḥzhes dang mtheb srin gyi se gol sgras ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs zhes dang thab kyi thal ba nas srin lag gis cung zad blangs pa dpral bar bskus te/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam mo// rjes la gnyis/ dang por mchod cing bzod par gsol ba ni/ thab tu mar blugs gzar gang dgang gzar la reg par phul la/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ zhes dang*/ slar yang 'bar ba me lha'i rnam par gyur par bsams la/ bsreg rdzas lhag ma rnams bdun nam bcu gcig sogs kyis phul mthar/ byon zan gyi skabs ltar mar dgang blugs gsum gshegs skyems su phul/ me lha'i gtor ma oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra na maḥta thā ga ta sogs lan gsum gyis phul/ mtshan sngags re re'i sngon du 'gro ba'i phyi mchod nang mchod/

'jig rten dbang phyug sogs kyis bstod la/ me lha'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dang bar du gcod pa thams cad dang*/ gsang sngags lhag chad du gyur pa'i nyes pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa lta bu 'dod don gang yin zhus/ bdag las dang po pa'i gang zag tu gyur pas ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang*/ sngags ma dag pa dang*/ cho ga 'khrul pa dang*/ yo byad dman pa la sogs pa skyon du gyur pa thams cad bzod cing sbyang bar mdzad du gsol lo// zhes brjod/ gnyis pa gshegs gsol bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan pa ni/ lag pa gnyis mtheb srin se gol dang bcas te/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra gats+tsha zhes brjod pas ye shes pa rang gi gnas su gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsams la/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ sogs kyis gnas gsum bsrung*/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rta mchog rol pa 'grub gyur nas/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i bsngo ba dang smon lam gyi rgyas gdab/ che ba'i che mchog la sogs pa bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis mtha' brgyan/ thun mong gi dngos grub sgrub pa la ni thal ba 'phral du 'phyags pas btub kyi/ mchog sgrub pa la ni me nam mnal gyi bar mi bsgul/ me mnal nas thal ba phyags la rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu klung ngam ri rtse la sogs par bskyal lo// gal te bka' gter nyis 'dres kyi sgrub thabs dang 'bral bar sman raka gtor ma yod na/ gong gi mchod pa byin rlabs kyi oṃ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐ zhes pa'i rjes su/ bdud rtsi la oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañca a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭha/ rak+ta la oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rak+ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭha/ zhes byin rlabs lhag por brjod pa dang*/ 'das pa'i me lhar mchod 'bul gyi bdud rtsi 'bul ba'i gong du/ sarba pañca a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ zhes dang brgyud rim sogs la phul ba'i rjes su/

ma hā rak+ta kha raṃ khā hi/ zhes pa tsam gyi thus shing gal te de gsum dbul ba'i tshigs bcad yod pa ltar na'ang 'bul sngags kyi sngon du sbyor tshul shes par bya'o// smras pa/ dge ba'i mi mthun phyogs gyur bag chags bcas// mthar byed zhi ba'i phrin las 'di mthong tshe// dpal mgrin khros pa'i mi bzad mig gi mes// yid srubs rags lus bsregs pa'i grags pa 'gog /skyer sgang pa las nyer brgyud rta mchog lha// bsgom bzlas nus pa thogs pa med pa'i sgra// sngags nus byung ba'i sgrub thabs 'dis dben rnams// rir skyes skom pa smig rgyur snyegs pa bzhin// 'di bgyis dge ba'i bi shwa na ra'i bus// sdig sgrib nyer 'tshe'i bsreg bya yongs zos nas// dge legs phan bde'i dkar gsal snang ba cher// yid can ma lus dgyes dgur rtsen par shog /ces rta mgrin skyer sgang lugs kyi sbyin sreg cho ga me lha dgyes pa'i mchod sprin zhes bya ba 'di ni/ hor yul gdong thog bla ma sangs rgyas rin chen pa'i gsung gis bskul ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis le rang chu tshan khar bris so// // ༄༅// bsngo ba smon lam mdor bsdus bzhugs so// ༄༅// dkon mchog mchod pa phul dang bdag cag la// dkon mchog gsum du rnam brtags gson gshin ched// dkon mchog mchod pa'i dkor rdzas 'brel yod rnams// dkon mchog skyabs bral yul du skye ma gyur// dkon mchog phyogs la dad pa'i zhing sa gshin// dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 'gro'i sa bon gzung*// dkon mchog thugs rje'i drod gsher rtag 'thung zhing*// dkon mchog gsum lam so nam brtson par shog /dkon mchog yon tan sdong bu bskyed bsrings rtser// dkon mchog go 'phang snye ma g.yur du za// dkon mchog phrin las 'bru bcud dga' ston la// dkon mchog skyabs su 'gro kun mgron gnyer shog /ces bsngo ba smon lam mdor bsdus dkon mchog mtshan gyi rin chen mgul rgyan zhes bya ba 'di'ang tshul rin gyis so//
// ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
